name: Flow-state classification for a connected water-chain edge (F1-F6), with an inferred coverage state and refusal

statement.latest: \text{For a declared edge } e=(u,v) \text{ (per PROP-FLOOD-04) with far/receiving node } v\text{: let } r_{04}\in\{u\to v, v\to u, \text{UNRESOLVED}, \text{REFUSED}(\cdot)\} \text{ be PROP-FLOOD-04's own readout on } e; \quad r_{01}^{v}\in\{\text{RISING},\text{FALLING},\text{FLAT},\text{NO\_READOUT}\} \text{ be PROP-FLOOD-01's own trend readout on } v \text{ (}k\ge2\text{ readings, FLAT read as STALLED when persistent per a declared window)}; \quad g\in\{\text{OPEN},\text{CLOSED},\text{PUMPING},\text{FAULT},\text{undeclared}\} \text{ be the declared control-structure state on } e; \quad m\in\{\text{RISING},\text{STEADY},\text{FALLING},\text{BACKFLOW},\text{undeclared}\} \text{ be a community surface-state report on } v\text{ (RELAYED).}\quad \text{Each of } r_{04}, r_{01}^{v} \text{ may itself be OBSERVED (direct) or STRONG\_INFERENCE (via RULE-STALL-01/RULE-DIR-01 from a measured anchor elsewhere in the connected component, carrying an anchor-id list and an ordinal confidence = the weakest evidence-strength rung used); an undeclared/absent input of any kind collapses to ABSENT for classification purposes regardless of which of these two it would have been.}\quad \text{Derive four total per-tick classes } D\in\{\text{FORWARD},\text{REVERSE},\text{UNRESOLVED},\text{ABSENT}\}\text{ (from } r_{04}\text{), } T\in\{\text{FALLING},\text{RISING},\text{STALLED},\text{ABSENT}\}\text{ (from } r_{01}^{v}\text{), } C\in\{\text{OPEN},\text{CLOSED},\text{PUMPING},\text{FAULT},\text{ABSENT}\}=g\text{, } M\in\{\text{BACKFLOW},\text{RISING},\text{STEADY},\text{FALLING},\text{ABSENT}\}=m.\quad \text{readout is a TOTAL function, refusal checked first:}\quad \boxed{\text{readout}:=\begin{cases} \text{REFUSED(NO\_INPUT)} & D=T=C=M=\text{ABSENT} \\ F5 & \text{else if } M=\text{BACKFLOW} \\ F4 & \text{else if } D=\text{REVERSE} \\ F1 & \text{else if } D=\text{FORWARD}, T=\text{FALLING}, C\ne\text{FAULT} \\ F6(\{F1,F2\}) & \text{else if } D=\text{FORWARD}, T\in\{\text{FALLING},\text{RISING}\}, C=\text{FAULT} \\ F2 & \text{else if } D=\text{FORWARD}, T=\text{RISING}, C\ne\text{FAULT} \\ F3 & \text{else if } D=\text{FORWARD}, T=\text{STALLED} \\ F6(\{F4,F5\}) & \text{else if } D=\text{FORWARD}, T=\text{ABSENT} \\ F6(\{F4\}) & \text{else if } D=\text{UNRESOLVED} \\ F6(\varnothing) & \text{else } (D=\text{ABSENT}) \end{cases}}\quad \text{Every } F6 \text{ row carries an explicit ruled-out subset of } \{F1,\dots,F5\}\text{, never a bare unlabeled '?'; the fault-veto rows exist because a faulted/absent control state must never license a free-flow (F1) or delayed-free (F2) claim on gradient alone (rule 5) -- it does not veto F3/F4/F5, which are not free-flow claims.}
statement.note_ascii: For a declared edge e=(u,v) per PROP-FLOOD-04 with far/receiving node v: D (FORWARD/REVERSE/UNRESOLVED/ABSENT) is read directly off PROP-FLOOD-04's own readout(t) on e (ABSENT iff PROP-FLOOD-04 itself REFUSED, for any reason); T (FALLING/RISING/STALLED/ABSENT) is read off PROP-FLOOD-01's own trend readout on v, with FLAT read as STALLED exactly when it is persistent across a declared window (max-min <= a declared epsilon over the window; this is the same construction thailand_flood_kg's flow_stall.py calls _is_persistently_stalled, an extension of PROP-FLOOD-01's own 2-point epsilon-sign discipline to a whole window, not a new arithmetic formula), ABSENT iff NO_READOUT or fewer than 2 readings; C (OPEN/CLOSED/PUMPING/FAULT/ABSENT) is the declared control-structure state on e, undeclared collapsing to ABSENT; M (BACKFLOW/RISING/STEADY/FALLING/ABSENT) is a community surface-state report on v, tagged RELAYED, undeclared collapsing to ABSENT. Either D or T (or both) MAY be produced not from a direct reading but from RULE-STALL-01 or RULE-DIR-01 (declared consistency inference rules over a measured anchor elsewhere in the connected component) -- in that case the classifier still only ever sees the resulting FORWARD/REVERSE/... or FALLING/RISING/STALLED value plus, separately reported alongside (never folded into the classification itself), the anchor-id list that licensed the inference and an ordinal confidence equal to the WEAKEST evidence-strength rung among the anchor(s) used (VERIFIED_LIVE=4 > VERIFIED_STALE=3 > RELAYED=2 > COMMUNITY=1 > INSTINCT=0, min not average, per thailand_flood_kg's FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.3). readout(t) is a TOTAL function evaluated in fixed precedence, refusal checked first: (1) REFUSED(NO_INPUT) iff D=T=C=M=ABSENT (all four collapsed inputs absent -- the only refusal case, never a default for a merely-unmeasured node/edge); else (2) F5 (internal surcharge) iff M=BACKFLOW -- a direct community report of backflow/overflow is treated as the strongest available signal and is checked before the gradient/trend rules; else (3) F4 (tailwater/backwater) iff D=REVERSE; else, for D=FORWARD: (4a) F1 (free) iff T=FALLING and C is not FAULT; (4b) F2 (delayed) iff T=RISING and C is not FAULT; (4c) F3 (blocked) iff T=STALLED (this row is NOT vetoed by C=FAULT -- STALLED-despite-gradient is itself evidence of blockage, consistent with a faulted structure, not a free-flow claim rule 5 would forbid); (4d) if T=FALLING or T=RISING but C=FAULT, the result is DOWNGRADED from F1/F2 to F6 with ruled_out={F1,F2} -- a faulted/unknown-state control structure must never be read as licensing a free-flow or delayed-free-flow claim on gradient evidence alone (founder rule 5: never say 'in theory water can flow' over a faulted structure); (4e) F6 with ruled_out={F4,F5} iff T=ABSENT (forward gradient known, but no trend evidence at the receiving end -- backwater and surcharge are both already ruled out by the forward gradient itself, but free/delayed/blocked cannot yet be distinguished); else (5) F6 with ruled_out={F4} iff D=UNRESOLVED (gradient not distinguishable from zero at PROP-FLOOD-04's own resolution -- rules out clear backwater, nothing else); else (6) F6 with ruled_out={} iff D=ABSENT (no gradient information at all, only trend/control/community, if any, known) -- this is the row that realizes the founder's correction 'F6, not REFUSED, whenever any input is present': D=ABSENT alone never refuses the edge as long as T, C, or M carries any real value, and even when none of T/C/M add anything the classifier still reports F6(ruled_out={}), an honest 'unknown but at least an edge/attempt was declared' state, never collapsed with the true all-absent REFUSED case.

definitions.D (edge direction class): a 4-valued collapse of PROP-FLOOD-04's own 6-row readout(t): FORWARD iff u->v, REVERSE iff v->u, UNRESOLVED iff UNRESOLVED, ABSENT iff ANY of PROP-FLOOD-04's REFUSED reasons fired (UNDECLARED_EDGE/MISSING_INPUT/STALE_INPUT/DATUM_MISMATCH/CONTROL_STATE_MISSING/CONTROLLED) -- the specific REFUSED reason is not distinguished by this object, only that PROP-FLOOD-04 itself produced no directional value
definitions.T (far-node trend class): a 4-valued collapse of PROP-FLOOD-01's own trend readout on the far/receiving node v: FALLING/RISING read verbatim, STALLED read from a persistent FLAT (max-min <= a declared epsilon across a declared persistence window, thailand_flood_kg's _is_persistently_stalled convention, itself an extension of PROP-FLOOD-01's 2-point sign discipline to a window, not a new formula), ABSENT iff NO_READOUT or fewer than k=2 readings
definitions.C (control-structure state): the declared operational state of e's control structure (gate/pump), 5-valued: OPEN/CLOSED/PUMPING read verbatim from the same declared source PROP-FLOOD-04 already requires; FAULT is a NEW value this proposal adds (a structure whose declared state is explicitly a fault/malfunction reading, e.g. thailand_flood_kg's ST.SPS pump status field reading a fault code -- distinct from CLOSED/PUMPING, which are functioning-but-not-open states); ABSENT iff undeclared/missing/stale
definitions.M (community surface-state report): a RELAYED report of the local surface state at v: RISING/STEADY/FALLING/BACKFLOW, undeclared collapsing to ABSENT; BACKFLOW is the strongest of these four and is checked before any gradient/trend rule
definitions.F1..F5 (determinate flow classes): F1 free (drains as expected, forward gradient + confirmed continuing decrease at the receiving end); F2 delayed (forward gradient + receiving end still rising -- moving into a filling reservoir/basin, not yet draining out); F3 blocked (forward gradient persists but the receiving end is not falling -- gradient without progress, structural not hydraulic); F4 tailwater/backwater (gradient at or below zero at PROP-FLOOD-04's own resolution, i.e. REVERSE); F5 internal surcharge/backflow (a direct community report of backflow or overflow at v)
definitions.F6 (unknown-but-bounded): the honest default whenever no F1-F5 row matches but at least one of D,T,C,M is not ABSENT; ALWAYS carries an explicit ruled_out subset of {F1,F2,F3,F4,F5} (possibly empty) stating exactly which determinate classes this edge/tick's actual inputs already exclude -- never a bare unlabeled '?' and never conflated with REFUSED
definitions.inferred_value(A): a generic wrapper record (iv_state in {Present, Absent, Inferred}, iv_value: option A, iv_confidence: option strength, iv_anchors: list of anchor ids) used to produce D or T from an anchor's measured reading via a declared consistency rule rather than a direct reading on e/v itself; Present = direct reading; Inferred = produced by RULE-STALL-01/RULE-DIR-01 below, carrying the anchor ids and the weakest evidence-strength rung among them as iv_confidence; Absent = neither. This is the general 'inferred' third coverage-state primitive PROP-FLOOD-06.v5's own honest_caveats deferred to a v6 pass -- registered HERE, as its own primitive, per this repository's Toledo-first reuse gate (a genuinely new construction needs its own lookup/compatibility pass before derivation, not folding it silently into an unrelated object's next version bump)
definitions.RULE-STALL-01: 'no way to fall despite it having room to' -- if a far anchor's OWN measured trend is persistently STALLED across a declared window AND the measured count of running pumps on the connecting run is 0 AND a community report on that run says 'not yet falling', infer the whole intervening (un-gauged) run as STALLED; iv_confidence := the weakest of the three evidence strengths used (anchor/pump-measurement/community), never their average
definitions.RULE-DIR-01: 'two anchors agree' -- if a run is bounded by two measured anchors (near and far) and both show the SAME trend direction (both RISING or both FALLING), infer the intervening run moves the same direction; iv_confidence := the weaker of the two anchors' own strengths. Declared limitation (stated, not fixed by this rule): does not itself check for a hidden control structure mid-run -- a run known to contain one must be declared edge_kind=CONTROLLED and split, per thailand_flood_kg's own typology doc
definitions.strength (evidence-strength ladder): VERIFIED_LIVE(4) > VERIFIED_STALE(3) > RELAYED(2) > COMMUNITY(1) > INSTINCT(0), the same 5-rung ladder thailand_flood_kg's FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.3 declares; combining several sources' strengths always takes the MINIMUM (weakest link), never an average -- this is an INSTINCT-rule (a declared convention for combining confidence), not itself a new Toledo equation

decision_table.when: D=ABSENT AND T=ABSENT AND C=ABSENT AND M=ABSENT
M!=BACKFLOW AND D=FORWARD AND T=FALLING AND C!=FAULT
M!=BACKFLOW AND D=FORWARD AND T in {FALLING,RISING} AND C=FAULT
M!=BACKFLOW AND D=FORWARD AND T=RISING AND C!=FAULT

readout_classes.precedence_note: Rows checked top-to-bottom, first match wins; the 10 rows exhaustively partition the 4x4x5x5=400 (D,T,C,M) combinations (Coq's pattern match is checked exhaustive by the compiler, per row 3's D=REVERSE and rows 4-8's D=FORWARD covering all T values including a T not yet listed being unreachable -- T is only 4-valued, all 4 covered across rows 4/6/7/8).
readout_classes.note: F3 is deliberately NOT vetoed by C=FAULT (row 7 has no C condition) -- 'gradient without progress' is itself consistent with, not contradicted by, a faulted structure; only F1/F2 (free-flow claims) require the veto per founder rule 5.

claim_boundary: No hydrological/hydraulic flow model of any kind is asserted beyond what PROP-FLOOD-01/04 already assert (no discharge/velocity/volume estimate). This object is strictly a case-classifier over four already-collapsed, finite-valued inputs (D,T,C,M): readout(t) is a total function computed on those four values plus the fixed precedence table above, refusal checked first and only for the all-ABSENT case; an inferred D or T (via RULE-STALL-01/RULE-DIR-01) never carries more classificatory weight than a directly-observed one -- the classifier treats both identically once collapsed, the anchor/confidence metadata is carried alongside for reporting, never folded into the decision itself.

parents.evidence: D is a direct 4-valued collapse of PROP-FLOOD-04's own 6-row total readout(t) (u->v/v->u/UNRESOLVED/6 REFUSED reasons); this object supplies no gradient arithmetic of its own -- Delta_e(t), epsilon_u+epsilon_v, and the refusal precedence are all PROP-FLOOD-04's, cited not restated. PROP-FLOOD-04 (PR #61) is itself an unmerged sibling proposal at time of this registration, same status as its citation in PROP-FLOOD-05a; this citation must be re-checked against PROP-FLOOD-04's actual registered form once that PR lands.

T is a direct 4-valued collapse of PROP-FLOOD-01's own RISING/FALLING/FLAT/NO_READOUT trend readout applied to the far node v's own reading series; STALLED is read from a persistent FLAT (a windowed extension of the same 2-point epsilon-sign discipline, not a new formula, matching thailand_flood_kg's own documented convention). RULE-STALL-01 and RULE-DIR-01 (below) also consume PROP-FLOOD-01 trend readouts at anchor nodes as their own inputs -- a second, distinct reuse of the same object, for the inference layer rather than the direct-edge case.

C (control-structure state) reuses PROP-FLOOD-05a's own declared control-state vocabulary (OPEN/CLOSED/PUMPING) verbatim; FAULT is the one genuinely NEW value this proposal adds to that vocabulary (a structure whose declared state is itself a fault/malfunction reading), used only to gate F1/F2 out per founder rule 5 -- it does not otherwise participate in PROP-FLOOD-05a's own HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE/burden construction, which this object does not reuse.

The classifier's own case-split (a finite decision table over a bounded number of retained, already-collapsed distinctions D/T/C/M, each itself ultimately grounded in a delta_R retained-difference reading via PROP-FLOOD-01/04) is a composition of already-forced retained-difference readouts, not a new continuum construction; no new delta_R instance is introduced by this object beyond what its two direct parents already instantiate.

RULE-STALL-01.name: far anchor persistently stalled + zero pumps + community no-drop => run STALLED
inputs: far_anchor_trend (measured PROP-FLOOD-01 reading, persistently STALLED across a declared window)
pumps_running (measured count, on the connecting run)
RULE-STALL-01.fires_when: far_anchor_trend = STALLED (persistent) AND pumps_running = 0 AND community_no_drop = true
RULE-STALL-01.output: Inferred(STALLED), confidence = min(far_anchor_strength, pump_measurement_strength, community_strength), anchors = [far_anchor_id, pump_source_id, community_report_id]

RULE-DIR-01.name: two bounding anchors agree in direction => intervening run moves the same direction
RULE-DIR-01.fires_when: near_anchor_trend = far_anchor_trend AND near_anchor_trend in {RISING, FALLING}
RULE-DIR-01.output: Inferred(near_anchor_trend), confidence = min(near_anchor_strength, far_anchor_strength), anchors = [near_anchor_id, far_anchor_id]
RULE-DIR-01.declared_limitation: does not itself check for a hidden control structure mid-run; a run known to contain one must be declared edge_kind=CONTROLLED and split into shorter runs first

RULE-COMMUNITY-01.name: community report alone, no measured anchor reachable
RULE-COMMUNITY-01.status: NOT formalised as an inferred_value producer in this registration -- it is already represented directly as the M input (a first-class, always-weak/RELAYED input to the decision table itself, rows 2/5/8/9/10), not as a third way to produce D or T. Recorded here only to state explicitly that this typology term is fully accounted for elsewhere in this object, not silently dropped.

genesis_compatibility.gate: readout_genesis Part V-A, A.13 'Gate 2 -- Three-Valued Admissibility' (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, lines ~3768-3776) -- the same gate PROP-FLOOD-01 and PROP-FLOOD-04 already cite for their own refusal/UNRESOLVED discipline
genesis_compatibility.quote: "𝒞(ξ | c, 𝒯) ∈ {1, 0, ⊥}      1 admitted · 0 obstructed · ⊥ unresolved" ... "`Adm = 1` ⇒ expand; `Adm = 0` ⇒ record the obstruction; `Adm = ⊥` ⇒ record it as **unresolved and do not guess**. `⊥` (unresolved, \"not yet known\") and `0` (obstructed, \"actively blocked\") are two different statuses, not one collapsed \"no\"" (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, lines 3771 and 3775-3776)
genesis_compatibility.note: This object is a downstream COMPOSITION of two already Gate-2-compatible readouts (PROP-FLOOD-01, -04), so no new ontological gate is invoked -- it needed a FRESH compatibility check (not merely inherited) because it collapses two independent three-valued sources plus two NEW inputs (C, M) into a single joint classification, and because it introduces a genuinely new state (Inferred, alongside Present/Absent) that neither parent's own admissibility mapping already covered. The mapping: REFUSED(NO_INPUT) is the case where the object cannot even be evaluated (stronger than ⊥ -- no retained distinction is available on any of the four component readouts at all, not merely an unresolved one); each determinate F1/F2/F3/F4/F5 row is the Genesis admitted value 1 (expand: a determinate class is asserted); F6 is the Genesis unresolved value ⊥ done RIGHT per the founder's own correction -- it is 'record it as unresolved and do not guess' made HONEST rather than SILENT, by additionally stating the ruled_out subset (what has already been obstructed/eliminated, Genesis's 0, even while the overall class remains ⊥). The Inferred coverage-state (RULE-STALL-01/-DIR-01) is itself a bounded admissibility move: it only ever promotes an otherwise-⊥ component to a determinate value by CITING which already-admitted (1) readouts elsewhere in the connected graph license it, via the anchors list -- it never asserts admissibility ex nihilo, and its confidence field (the weakest cited anchor's own evidence strength) is carried forward so a caller can still discount it, distinct from a directly-admitted (Present) reading.

honest_caveats: This is a case-classifier over four ALREADY-collapsed finite-valued inputs, not a new hydraulic model -- every arithmetic fact it consumes (the gradient sign, the trend sign, the persistence-window check) is PROP-FLOOD-01/04's or thailand_flood_kg's own already-documented derived convention (_is_persistently_stalled), never re-derived here.

The fault-veto (rows 5, ruling out F1/F2 when C=FAULT) deliberately does NOT veto F3 -- 'gradient present but no progress' is itself consistent with a faulted structure, not contradicted by it; only a free-flow claim (F1/F2) is forbidden on gradient evidence alone when the structure's own state is a known fault, per founder rule 5 verbatim ('ห้ามพูดว่าตามทฤษฎีน้ำไหลได้').

Monotonicity of the ruled_out set is NOT proved for the general case -- specifically, the M=BACKFLOW override (row 2) and the C=FAULT veto (row 5) can each retract a previously-asserted determinate class (e.g. a forward gradient + falling trend giving F1 can be downgraded to F6 the instant the control structure's state is later learned to be FAULT, and F1's own ruled_out set does NOT already contain F1 while F6's post-veto ruled_out set DOES contain F1 -- a genuine retraction, not a monotone refinement). This is disclosed, not hidden: a fixed monotonicity theorem is proved ONLY over the restricted fragment where M stays not-BACKFLOW and C stays not-FAULT throughout (`flow_ruled_out_monotone` in the .v file, revealing only D/T information never removes a previously ruled-out class); the general-case failure is recorded as an explicit Coq `Example` (`monotonicity_fails_on_fault_veto`) rather than silently asserted away -- per this repository's own AGENTS.md instruction to record counterexamples as first-class provenance, and per this task's own instruction to weaken and say so rather than force an unprovable claim.

The Inferred coverage-state (RULE-STALL-01/-DIR-01) is a GENERAL, reusable primitive registered here for the first time; it is intentionally generic over the value type it infers (Coq `inferred_value (A : Set)`) so PROP-FLOOD-06's own deferred v6 ask (an `inferred` third coverage state on cov5(U)'s components, with an ordinal confidence field and anchors) can import this same wrapper and its two ordering facts (`coverage3_rank`, `coverage3_rank_absent_lt_inferred`, `coverage3_rank_inferred_le_present`) rather than re-deriving them; PROP-FLOOD-06.v6 itself is explicitly NOT written by this registration -- only the reusable primitive it needs is.

RULE-STALL-01/-DIR-01 are declared consistency rules (INSTINCT-rule, per thailand_flood_kg's own tagging), not Toledo theorems about physical flow; they only ever promote a component from Absent to Inferred by CITING which already-measured anchor(s) license it -- an inference is never asserted without its anchor-id list, and confidence is always the MINIMUM (weakest link), never an average, of the cited anchors' own evidence strengths.

F6's ruled_out set is a per-row FIXED constant in this registration (rows 5/8/9/10 each carry a hand-declared subset), not itself computed from a general elimination-rule engine; a future version could widen this to a compositional elimination-fact accumulator (each fired sub-rule contributing its own eliminated class) rather than a fixed per-row literal, if a genuinely richer input space is added later.

Not yet implemented in thailand_flood_kg's actual `flow_stall.py` runtime code -- that module's own docstring states explicitly that its F1-F6 appendix is 'a candidate that has not passed Toledo, must not be cited as a theorem, must not be used on the public web page until registered' (FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.8); this registration is the Toledo-side artifact that section calls for, not a claim that the runtime code has been wired to call it.

The community input M's BACKFLOW value dominating everything (row 2, checked before the gradient/trend rules) is itself a design choice, not a proof: a false or stale community report of backflow would incorrectly force F5 ahead of a genuinely free-flowing gradient reading; this is recorded as an open calibration/precedence question for whoever operationalises this object, not resolved here.
falsifier: A systematic mismatch between a classified F1/F2 edge and a later-confirmed non-draining outcome (or the reverse: a classified F3/F4 edge later shown flowing freely at |Delta_e(t)|>epsilon with the control structure open and no fault) falsifies the classifier's own case-table assignment for that combination of inputs, not PROP-FLOOD-01/04's underlying arithmetic (which remains definitionally true given its own inputs). A confirmed case where RULE-STALL-01 or RULE-DIR-01 fires (Inferred) and the later-measured true value at that node/edge contradicts the inferred one falsifies that specific inference rule's own reliability (not this object's classification arithmetic, which correctly propagates whatever D/T value it was given) and must be recorded as a first-class counterexample, per this repository's provenance discipline, before the rule is reused again on the same class of run.

origin.source: New derivation/proposal: a community flood-readout application (FloodConnect), 2026-09-27, extracting the F1-F6 vocabulary/typology from an external assistant's candidate proposal (thailand_flood_kg's FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.8, tagged RELAYED-external-proposal there, adopted-as-convention for vocabulary only) and formalising it here as this repository's own Toledo-first PROP-FLOOD-07 derivation, per that document's own explicit instruction that registering it is 'not the job of that worker' and belongs to whoever opens the Toledo PR next.

version_history.statement: Initial registration: D/T/C/M four-input collapse, 10-row total decision table (F1-F6 + REFUSED(NO_INPUT)), fault-veto restricted to F1/F2, generic Inferred coverage-state primitive (inferred_value(A)) with RULE-STALL-01/RULE-DIR-01, restricted monotonicity theorem plus an explicit Coq counterexample for the unrestricted claim.
version_history.reason: Founder instruction 2026-09-27 to register a Toledo-first PROP-FLOOD-07 for the F1-F6 candidate typology in thailand_flood_kg/docs/FLOW_STALL_TYPOLOGY.md sec.8, implementing the 'inferred' coverage-state primitive PROP-FLOOD-06.v5's own honest_caveats deferred to a v6 pass, so that a future PROP-FLOOD-06.v6 can import it rather than re-derive it.
